"Electric 10s" just went on sale in Texas. The game has ten full prize levels with six top prizes of $30,000. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

Today's free summary of "Electric 10s" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
2772.headline: A brand-new game to watch

2773.body:
"Sugar Skull Cash" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $5 game with four top prizes of $100,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Everything here about "Sugar Skull Cash" comes from official Texas lottery numbers, current through September 28.
